description: This Java source file defines the 'ExceptionMapper' class, a helper utility for mapping SSL-related exceptions to specific Ditto exceptions with detailed messages. It facilitates consistent error handling for SSL issues within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging module.

classes.name: ExceptionMapper
classes.description: A final helper class that maps SSL exceptions to more meaningful Ditto-specific exceptions, enhancing error reporting and handling within the SSL connection processes.

methods.name: ExceptionMapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ExceptionMapper with given DittoHeaders, defaulting to empty headers if null.

methods.name: fatalError
methods.description: Preconfigures a builder for fatal ConnectionUnavailableExceptions with a specific error message.

methods.name: badFormat
methods.description: Preconfigures a builder for ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException when a bad certificate format is encountered.

methods.name: handleExceptions
methods.description: Executes a supplier that may throw SSL-related exceptions. Catches specific SSL exceptions and maps them to appropriate Ditto exceptions with detailed cause and context.
